svg.text: Defense in depth for MCP: five rings, none of them optional
Each ring assumes the one inside it has failed. "The model will behave" is not a ring.

g.text: MODEL
SERVER DESIGN
CREDENTIALS
CLIENT POLICY
ISOLATION + HUMANS
0 · Model behaviour (the thing you don't control)
Good models refuse obvious injections. Treat that as luck, not a control.
Mark untrusted content in tool output; it helps, it does not guarantee.
1 · Server design (Module 3)
Intent-level tools · reads and writes separated · parameterized queries
allowlists for paths/URLs · minimal output · no secrets in results
2 · Credentials
Read-only DB users and connections · scoped, short-lived API tokens
one credential per server · injected via {env:} / {file:}, never literal
3 · Client policy (OpenCode)
permission: allow reads · ask writes · deny raw tools · per-agent scopes
enabled:false for idle servers · never --auto with write tools
4 · Isolation, review, audit, humans
pin versions, read the source, prefer containers for local servers
log every tool call (session export, taps) · review third-party servers
org allowlist of servers · managed config · rotate on incident
